communications_activity.label: Communications activity
communications_activity.value: Radio broadcasting, cable television network (TV One) and digital media targeting Black American and urban audiences

network_distribution_assets.label: Network / distribution assets
network_distribution_assets.value: Owned and operated radio stations, syndicated radio programming, cable network TV One, and owned digital sites

subscriber_audience_measure.label: Subscriber / audience measure
subscriber_audience_measure.value: Reaches most of Black America across platforms; digital network draws large monthly unique visitors and video impressions

license_spectrum_rights.label: License / spectrum rights
license_spectrum_rights.value: FCC broadcast station licenses for owned radio stations in urban markets

coverage_distribution_reach.label: Coverage / distribution reach
coverage_distribution_reach.value: Radio stations in about sixteen urban U.S. markets; multi-media reach to the large majority of Black America

advertising_carriage_economics_broadcast.label: Advertising / carriage economics [broadcasting]
advertising_carriage_economics_broadcast.value: Advertising sold across radio, TV and digital to reach Black audiences; cable network also earns carriage fees from distributors

notes: Evidence includes older and inconsistent figures (station counts, ownership stakes); described qualitatively.
